zh: 最近有一个词很火，叫 AI 超市，甚至有人把它称为下一个创业风口。
en: A new term is trending: the AI store. Some even call it the next startup opportunity.

zh: AI 超市到底是什么？它凭什么赚钱？甘肃的普通人有没有机会参与？
en: What is an AI store, how does it make money, and can ordinary people in Gansu take part?

zh: AI 超市不是实体店，也不是把几十个 AI 软件链接摆进一个网站。
en: An AI store is not a physical shop or a website filled with AI software links.

zh: 它把分散的模型、工具和智能体，按照不同行业和业务问题重新组合。
en: It combines scattered models, tools, and agents around specific industries and business problems.

zh: 最终变成客户买得到、用得起、有人交付的解决方案。
en: The result is an affordable solution that customers can buy and someone can deliver.

zh: 普通超市不生产矿泉水和方便面，但负责选品、分类、陈列、交易和售后。
en: A supermarket does not make its products. It selects, organizes, sells, and supports them.

zh: AI 超市不一定训练大模型，而是从大量 AI 能力里选产品，再接进客户业务。
en: An AI store need not train a model. It selects useful capabilities and connects them to the business.

zh: 一家本地门店每天要写文案、做海报、回复咨询、整理客户信息、培训员工。
en: A local store writes copy, makes posters, answers inquiries, organizes customer data, and trains staff.

zh: 老板想买的不是某个软件，而是少做重复工作、及时回复客户、稳定生产内容。
en: The owner does not want another app. They want less repetitive work, faster replies, and steady content.

zh: AI 超市的核心价值是四件事：选工具、搭工作流、教会员工，并且持续负责。
en: Its core value is choosing tools, building workflows, training staff, and staying responsible.

zh: 那它靠什么赚钱？
en: So how does it make money?

zh: 第一层是行业工具箱，把行业工具、提示词和操作模板整理成标准产品。
en: Layer one is an industry toolkit: tools, prompts, and operating templates packaged as a product.

zh: 这种模式容易开始，但门槛低；只卖工具链接，很快就会被复制。
en: It is easy to start but easy to copy when the offer is only a list of links.

zh: 第二层是项目交付费。
en: Layer two is project delivery fees.

zh: 先诊断企业问题，再搭知识库、智能客服、内容工作流和销售跟进流程。
en: Diagnose the business, then build knowledge, customer service, content, and sales workflows.

zh: 卖的不是工具，而是部署、培训和验收；收入可能更高，也更考验交付能力。
en: This sells deployment, training, and acceptance, not tools. Revenue may be higher, but delivery is harder.

zh: 第三层是订阅和运维收入。
en: Layer three is subscription and operations revenue.

zh: 系统上线后，模型、知识库、员工培训、算力和效果检查都需要持续维护。
en: After launch, models, knowledge, training, compute, and performance all need ongoing maintenance.

zh: 客户持续付费，不是因为自动扣费，而是因为系统还在持续创造价值。
en: Customers keep paying only when the system keeps creating value, not because billing is automatic.

zh: 一旦不好用、没人维护、成本失控，客户一样会停止支付。
en: If it stops working, lacks support, or costs too much, customers will stop paying.

zh: 第四层才是平台和连锁。
en: Only layer four is platforms and chains.

zh: 行业方案要先在多家真实企业跑通，交付、价格、售后和验收标准都能复制。
en: The solution must work in real companies before delivery, pricing, support, and acceptance can be replicated.

zh: 连锁一定是最后一步。没跑通真实客户就招加盟、收加盟费，只是在卖未验证的故事。
en: Chains come last. Selling franchises before real customer results means selling an untested story.

zh: AI 超市未来不会只是一个软件商城。
en: The future AI store will be more than a software marketplace.

zh: 第一阶段，拼的是谁的工具多。
en: Stage one competes on the number of tools.

zh: 第二阶段，拼的是谁更懂行业。
en: Stage two competes on industry understanding.

zh: 第三阶段，拼的是谁能把 AI 接进企业流程。
en: Stage three competes on connecting AI to business workflows.

zh: 最后拼的是谁能持续运营、保证安全，并且对结果负责。
en: In the end, the winner operates continuously, protects safety, and takes responsibility for results.

zh: 工具会越来越便宜，模型能力也会越来越普及。
en: Tools will get cheaper and model capabilities will become common.

zh: 但懂本地客户、懂真实需求、能到现场交付的人，反而越来越有价值。
en: People who understand local customers, real needs, and on-site delivery will become more valuable.

zh: 甘肃现在也在推进模型即服务和智能体即服务。
en: Gansu is also advancing model-as-a-service and agent-as-a-service.

zh: 机会不是再造一个大模型，而是把这些能力带进兰州和甘肃企业的真实场景。
en: The opportunity is not another foundation model, but bringing these capabilities into real Gansu businesses.

zh: 我现在在兰州尝试的，也接近这个方向。
en: What I am testing in Lanzhou follows this direction.

zh: 先从一家企业、一个岗位、一个重复流程开始，看它能不能真正产生价值。
en: Start with one company, one role, and one repeated workflow, then test whether it creates value.

zh: 跑通了再标准化，标准化了再复制，能持续交付了才谈规模。
en: Prove it, standardize it, replicate it, and discuss scale only after delivery is sustainable.

zh: 这才是普通人进入 AI 行业比较现实的一条路。
en: This is a realistic path for ordinary people entering the AI industry.

zh: 关注我，我是超哥，在兰州记录 AI 创业。
en: Follow me. I am Chao, documenting AI entrepreneurship in Lanzhou.
